# Fahyan

> Professional Photographer & Video Editor

## Summary
Professional photographer and video editor specializing in visual storytelling, high-impact commercial imagery, and cinematic post-production across fashion, portraits, wildlife, and music events.

## Core Services
- Photography: Commercial, lifestyle, portrait, fashion, and wildlife photo shoots.
- Cinematography: Camera operation, event capture, short-film production, and short-form video creation.
- Post-Production: High-end video editing, color grading, sound design, and motion assembly.

## Key Portfolio Categories
- Wildlife Photography: High-resolution wilderness, animal behavior, and nature documentary stills.
- Portrait Photography: Studio headshots, editorial framing, and environmental portraiture.
- Fashion Photography: Lookbooks, apparel campaigns, and high-fashion editorial imagery.
- Concert Photography: Live stage performances, festival coverage, and low-light event capture.
- Featured Films & Short Reels: Commercials, narrative shorts, music videos, and viral social reels.
